左转不再等红灯。四个环道又小又慢（40 km/h），占地并不大；代价是上环和下环: Left turns no longer wait at traffic lights. The four loops are small and slow (40 km/h), so the interchange takes less land than you might expect; the price is weaving, as cars entering and leaving the loops cross the same short stretch, and that is where queues form first.
支路的车要等主路留出足够大的空当，才能拐出去。: Vehicles on the side road wait for a large enough gap in the main-road traffic before turning out.
左转先进入待转区，等专用绿灯一起出发。用进口展宽和额外相位，换取互不交叉的放行。: Left turns enter a waiting area first, then leave together on their dedicated green. Wider approaches and extra phases separate the movements.
高速跨过主干道。四条匝道把转向交给两端的信号路口，两个路口要一起协调。: The freeway crosses above the arterial. Four ramps bring turning traffic to two signalized terminals, whose operation must be coordinated.
两次交叉，把中间一段换成左侧行驶。上匝道的左转车不用再横穿对向直行。: Two crossovers switch the middle section to left-hand traffic. Left turns onto the freeway no longer cross opposing through traffic.
高度由图层与净空约束反推，非实测高程: Heights inferred from layers and clearance constraints, not surveyed
左转沿着中心向外旋开，用更长、更舒展的匝道避开交织。高速不断流，桥也铺得更远。: Left turns spiral around the center on longer, gentler ramps. Traffic flows without weaving, while bridges spread across more land.
三条高速相遇，一个慢速环道加一条半定向匝道，就能让所有方向互通。: Three highway arms connect through a slow loop and a semidirectional ramp, providing every turning movement.
两个象限加上环形匝道，部分左转绕过去。留下的信号路口仍需等待，也多占了一块土地。: Loops in two quadrants carry some left turns around the junctions. The remaining signalized terminals still require waiting, and the loops use more land.
左转在上游先穿过对向车道，来到道路外侧等待。到主路口时，左转和对向直行可以一起走: Left turns cross opposing traffic upstream and wait on the far side. At the main junction they can move alongside opposing through traffic.
真实道路在山谷里层层相接。线形来自 OpenStreetMap；桥面高度由层号、: Real roads overlap through a valley. Alignments come from OpenStreetMap; deck heights are inferred from layers, grades and clearance, not surveyed.
十六处交叉挤在中央，车辆要轮流寻找空当。转弯让直行，没有优先道路时让右侧来车。: Sixteen crossing conflicts crowd the center as drivers wait for gaps. Turning traffic yields to through traffic; without a priority road, drivers yield to the right.
把相交车流分时放行，跨相位的冲突画成空心环。左转亮绿灯时，仍要等对向直行的车。: Signals separate crossing streams in time; conflicts between different phases appear as hollow rings. Permissive left turns still yield to opposing through traffic.
八个冲突点，没有一个交叉。进环的车让环内车先行，用绕行换掉横穿。: Eight conflict points, none crossing. Entering drivers yield to circulating traffic, trading a detour for fewer crossing movements.
直行分居底下两层，左转沿上面两层定向匝道通过。没有交织，代价是更高的桥和更多桥面: Through traffic uses the lower two levels; direct left turns use the upper two. Weaving disappears, at the cost of taller bridges and more deck area.
先看最简单的相遇：支路等主路留出空当。少一条道路，冲突也少一些。: Start with the simplest meeting: a side road waits for gaps on the main road. One fewer approach also means fewer conflicts.
加上第四条路，冲突从 9 处变成 32 处。只靠让行，中央的十六处交叉很快开始互: A fourth approach takes conflicts from 9 to 32. With yielding alone, sixteen crossing points soon make drivers wait for one another.
红绿灯把相交车流分到不同时间。横穿有了顺序，代价是每个人都要轮到自己的绿灯。: Signals separate crossing traffic in time. Crossing has an order, but everyone must wait for their green.
也可以让所有车朝同一个方向绕行，把横穿变成合流。只剩八个冲突点，但进环仍要等空当: Or send everyone around the same way, replacing crossings with merges. Only eight conflict points remain, but entering traffic still waits for gaps.
车更多时，把左转单独排队、提前送进待转区。放行更有秩序，路口却更宽、周期也更长。: With more traffic, give left turns their own queues and advance them into waiting areas. Discharge becomes orderly, at the cost of a wider junction and a longer cycle.
把左转的横穿提前到上游，主路口就能让左转和直行同时走。主信号只需两相位，代价是多: Move the left-turn crossing upstream so left turns and through traffic can move together at the center. The main signal needs only two phases, but two upstream crossovers are added.
让高速跨过城市道路，直行终于不必等灯。转向车辆仍要经过桥下两个彼此协调的信号路口: Carry the motorway over the city road so through traffic no longer waits for lights. Turning vehicles still use two coordinated signal junctions below.
在两个路口换到左侧行驶，左转上高速时便不用横穿对向车流。冲突更少，但驾驶路线变得: Switch the arterial to the left at two crossovers. Left turns onto the motorway no longer cross opposing through traffic, but the driving pattern becomes unfamiliar.
不换行驶侧，也可以用两个环道替掉一部分左转。信号还在，环道额外占地。: Two loops can replace some left turns without changing the driving side. Signals remain, and the loops need extra land.
如果高速只从三个方向来，一个环道和一条半定向匝道就能互通。绕环的一股车流仍要减速: For only three motorway directions, one loop and a semidirect ramp provide all movements. The looping stream still has to slow down.
四个方向都要自由转向，就补成四个环道。没有平面交叉，环间这一小段却要交叉换道。: Four free-flowing approaches require four loops. At-grade crossings disappear, but drivers must exchange lanes in the short sections between loops.
把左转沿中心向外旋开，车流便不必交织。匝道更舒展，也延伸得更远；这里把竖向放大，: Spiral left-turn ramps around the center to remove weaving. The ramps are gentler and extend farther; vertical scale is expanded here to reveal the layers.
还可以让左转直接走最上面的两层，直行留在底下两层。车流不断，桥墩、桥面和高度都要: Or carry left turns directly on the upper two levels and leave through traffic below. Continuous flow costs more piers, deck area and height.
真实城市把这些办法叠在一起，还要迁就山谷、隧道和八个方向。黄桷湾的线形来自 OS: A real city combines these ideas around a valley, tunnels and eight directions. Huangjuewan uses OSM alignments; its five-level heights are constrained estimates, not surveys.
完整流向时转向占 40%，逐级加压至平台；取完整 5 分钟内按原定方向到达的最大: 40% turning demand where all turns exist, increased in steps until flow plateaus. Total and turning flows use their own best full five-minute window, counting only intended destinations. ≥ means saturation is unconfirmed. These are model results, not engineering capacities. Session pressure curves use the current OD separately. Land includes pavement, shoulders, a 10 m buffer and enclosed ground on a 2 m grid; remote approaches are excluded. Reference: 18 OpenStreetMap examples measured identically (ODbL 1.0); see Sources.
点一个方向，看示范车走完全程。: Pick a direction to watch a car travel the route.
完整模型入口到出口；直线仅作距离基准。半径取车道线形，车速为该段模型设定，不代表: From model entrance to exit; the straight line is only a distance reference. Radius comes from lane geometry. Speed is the setting for that segment, not a safe-speed recommendation. Conflicts include crossings, merges and diverges; weaving is counted separately.
OSM 未标出的交织区不计入；0 段不代表现实中不存在。高度为推断值。: Weaving not tagged in the imported model is not counted: zero does not prove none exists on site. Heights are inferred.
时间压缩回放 · 先看全程，再看转弯: Compressed replay · full route, then the turn
红灯 · 在停止线前等候: Red · waiting at the stop line
等前车或合流空当: Waiting for a car or a merging gap
本次示范未能驶出，可重播: This replay did not reach the exit; try again
用环道和上下跨分开车流，左转不用等红灯；代价是绕圈、低速和交织。: Loops and overpasses keep traffic apart without red lights for left turns, at the cost of detours, slow bends and weaving.
用红绿灯轮流分配路口，减少同时相交的车流；代价是等待，左转仍需让行。: Signals give crossing traffic separate turns, at the cost of waiting. Left turns still yield.
在有限的山地空间连接多个方向；代价是长匝道、多层桥和更早的路线选择。: Connect many directions in limited hilly space, at the cost of long ramps, stacked bridges and earlier lane choices.
少建一些环道，把部分车流交给信号路口；不再是同样的全自由流枢纽。: Fewer loops send some traffic through signals; this is no longer the same fully free-flowing system interchange.
左转改走定向匝道，消除环间交织；代价是更多、更高的桥。: Directional left-turn ramps remove weaving between loops, at the cost of more and taller bridges.
不用等固定红灯，但各方向都依赖空当和让行。: No fixed red lights, but each approach depends on gaps and yielding.
给左转专用车道和相位，减少与对向车流争路；占地与等待分配也随之改变。: Dedicated left-turn lanes and phases reduce competition with opposing traffic, changing land use and the allocation of waiting time.
规则四岔便于重复布置；黄桷湾的多方向、地形和既有道路使匝道不能简单复制。: A regular four-way layout can repeat its ramps. Huangjuewan's many directions, terrain and existing roads make that impractical.
为什么左转要绕圈: Why loop around to turn left?
先向右驶出，再绕 270°，就能朝左驶离，不必横穿对向车流；代价是路更长。: Exit right, then turn through 270° to head left without crossing oncoming traffic. The trade-off is a longer route.
环形匝道半径较小，模型设定车速为 40 km/h；缩小占地的同时，限制了转弯速度: The tight loop uses a model speed of 40 km/h. Its small radius saves space but limits turning speed.
上一个环道驶入的车与下一个环道驶出的车，在同一段辅助车道里交换位置；车多时容易互: Traffic joining from one loop and leaving for the next exchange positions in the same auxiliary section. Heavy traffic makes them impede one another.
让主线从上面跨过: Carry the mainline over the crossing
主线在不同高度相交，避免平面交叉；代价是桥梁和爬坡所需的距离。: Mainlines cross at different heights to avoid an at-grade crossing, requiring bridges and room to climb.
红灯时车头停在停止线前，把路口留给横向车流；代价是排队等待。: At red, the car stops before the stop line, leaving the junction to crossing traffic. The cost is a queue.
绿灯，左转还要等什么: What does a left turn wait for at green?
这里是许可左转。绿灯允许驶入，但仍要让对向直行；示范车在有足够空当后才转过去。: This is a permissive left turn. Green allows entry but still requires yielding to opposing through traffic. The demo car turns when a sufficient gap opens.
南北与东西轮流放行。它减少同时相交的车流，却不会消除同一绿灯中的左转冲突。: North–south and east–west take turns. This reduces simultaneous crossings but does not remove left-turn conflicts within the same green.
每相位有 3 秒黄灯和 2 秒全红，给已进入路口的车留出清空时间；这些时间不能用: Each phase has 3 seconds of yellow and 2 seconds of all-red for vehicles already in the junction to clear. That time is unavailable for a new green.
先认出口，再选车道: Choose the exit before the lane
多条通往不同方向的匝道在这里分开。提前选道能减少临近出口的横移；选错方向后不能随: Ramps to different destinations separate here. Choosing a lane early reduces last-minute lane changes; a wrong turn cannot be corrected by crossing arbitrarily.
用不同高度把相交路线分开；代价是桥梁、爬坡和更长的连接段。图中的高度由 OSM: Different heights separate crossing routes, requiring bridges, climbs and longer connections. Heights here are inferred from OSM layers and clearance constraints, not surveyed.
为什么不直接连过去: Why not connect in a straight line?
直线只用作距离参照，没有考虑地形、桥梁和既有道路。这里沿 OSM 连通路网选路，: The straight-line reference ignores terrain, bridges and existing roads. Routes follow connected OSM roads, and the detour is measured from the selected path.
匝道终究要接回道路，汇入时仍需空当。立体化分开了交叉，并没有让合流消失。: Ramps must rejoin a road and still need a gap. Grade separation removes crossings, not merging.
示范车使用同一交通模型的独立回放；行驶加快，短暂停车放慢，便于观察。: The demo is a separate replay of the same traffic model. Driving is accelerated and brief stops slowed down for clarity.
平面图纸暂不显示建筑，夜景保留此开关: Blueprint omits buildings; this setting is preserved for the night view.
